proposals.expected_failure_mode: If admissions systematically lag infections, peaks may occur too early and the model may compensate by distorting durations (E/I) or waning, reducing robustness across splits.
proposals.rationale: Remove explicit delay while keeping the same core SEIRS dynamics; uses I as a direct proxy for hospitalization-rate timing to test whether phase alignment can be captured via fitted transition rates rather than an imposed lag.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: If true lag varies over time or is near-zero, a fixed 1-week shift can misalign shoulders and troughs, causing split-to-split sensitivity.
proposals.rationale: Minimal lag to reflect plausible reporting/admission delay while avoiding the instability seen with longer delays; keeps structure unchanged to isolate the effect of a small timing shift.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: May over-shift peaks in some seasons/windows, degrading rolling performance and encouraging overfit to a particular validation segment.
proposals.rationale: Retain the best-performing delayed_I family member from prior discovery but cap delay at 2 to reduce over-shifting risk; appropriate given mechanistic note that admissions may lag an I-proxy.
